response: Reading is an important habit because it helps people learn new ideas and understand the world. Books can improve vocabulary, imagination, and concentration. Reading also allows us to experience places and situations that we may never see in our daily lives. Students who read regularly can often understand school subjects more easily because they become comfortable with language and information. Reading does not always have to mean studying difficult books. Stories, magazines, and interesting articles can all be useful. In my opinion, even a few minutes of reading every day can become a valuable habit that lasts a lifetime.

Learning programming is useful because it teaches people how to solve problems step by step. A program is made from clear instructions, so programmers must think carefully about what they want a computer to do. This way of thinking can also help in everyday life. Programming gives students the chance to build useful projects such as small games, websites, and tools. It can also introduce them to technology and possible careers. Even people who do not become professional programmers can benefit from understanding how software works. For these reasons, programming is a practical skill as well as a good exercise for logical thinking.
